subject: SaaS listing: commitment adjustment & billing flow for upcoming term
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Annette Chu <annette.chu@amazon.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-20T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: SaaS listing: commitment adjustment & billing flow for upcoming term

Hi Annette / Acme team,

Quick note to surface the upcoming contract term for Acme (RDW-ACME-2026-07). They want to push an increased annual commitment (approx +35% v. current) and onboard metered burst capacity for peak usage via the AWS listing. Two asks from our side:

1) Can we do a Seller Private Offer (SPO) that includes the increased annual commitment plus a separate metered SKU for burst?
2) Confirm the invoicing path: Acme prefers to receive a consolidated invoice directly from Redwood, with AWS acting as the procurement vehicle (Net30). That may influence how we set up billing/settlement on the marketplace listing.

Planned effective date: 2026-08-01. We need the PO flow and any marketplace paperwork (SPO template, listing amendment) finalized by 2026-07-27 to hit that date.

Attaching a draft PO for reference.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198]
[Attachment: redwood_draft_po_acme_20260720.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Annette Chu <annette.chu@amazon.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-07-20T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SaaS listing: commitment adjustment & billing flow for upcoming term

Hi Jonas — thanks for the note and the PO. Happy to help get this over the line. Short answers:

- Yes, you can submit an SPO that includes both a committed annual SKU and a separate metered SKU for burst usage. We typically recommend separate line items so consumption is tracked cleanly.

- For consolidated invoicing to flow from the seller, you should elect the "Seller Invoiced" settlement option on the SPO. That will let Redwood send one invoice directly to Acme while the Marketplace records the procurement. Net30 is supported, but make sure your payment terms are encoded in the SPO and the invoice flow is verified with your finance team.

Next steps I can take on our side:
- Share a filled SPO template for you to confirm line items and pricing (DocuSign link below).
- Open a request to the Marketplace billing team to validate settlement routing for Seller Invoiced billing.

DocuSign (SPO template): https://www.docusign.com/embedded/12345abcdef
SPO playbook doc: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/spo/rdw-acme-2026

If we want to meet the 2026-08-01 effective date, please confirm final prices and quantities by end-of-day Monday (2026-07-27 PST).

Best,
Annette Chu
Sr. Marketplace Program Manager, AWS
annette.chu@amazon.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Annette Chu <annette.chu@amazon.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-21T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SaaS listing: commitment adjustment & billing flow for upcoming term

Thanks Annette — quick clarifications from Redwood finance/ops:

- Pricing layout: we'll provide two SKUs: "Annual Commit (RDW-ACME-Y1)" and "Burst Tokens (RDW-BURST)". Please keep the burst as a metered SKU with a clear per-token USD rate and monthly reporting.

- Billing cadence: Redwood will issue monthly invoices that reflect committed amortization plus metered usage. For SPO, we'll include Acme PO number on each invoice and select Seller Invoiced settlement.

- Terms: Acme requested Net30; our standard seller policy allows Net30 for enterprise customers but requires the PO to reference the SPO ID. If AWS needs a separate document to bind Net30 to the SPO, please flag.

I've attached the draft SPO populated with our SKU IDs and proposed unit prices. Also attaching a sample invoice template mapping.

Action items we need from Acme:
- Confirm final annual quantity (licenses) and a target burst monthly threshold (for tiering).
- Confirm PO number and billing contact.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: aws_spo_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document); sample_invoice_mapping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: annette.chu@amazon.com
Date: 2026-07-21T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SaaS listing: commitment adjustment & billing flow for upcoming term

Hi Vanessa / Jonas — thanks for the clear breakdown. We reviewed internally and can confirm:

- Annual quantity: 1,350 seats (this is the committed unit).
- Burst: we agree to a metered SKU, and we expect typical monthly burst under 250k tokens but want an upper cap clause so we understand pricing sensitivity.
- PO number: ACME-PO-2026-4087. Please include this on invoices.
- Payment terms: Net30 is fine. We will need Redwood's remit-to/invoice instructions and the SPO ID on the PO to match in our ERP.

Next: please send a final SPO or listing amendment that includes the SKU IDs, per-unit pricing, and the SPO ID so we can route for signature.

Regards,
Taylor Morales
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com
[Attachment: acme_po_authorization.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acme.com, annette.chu@amazon.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-22T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SaaS listing: commitment adjustment & billing flow for upcoming term

Perfect — thanks Taylor and Annette. Summary & next steps to lock schedule for 2026-08-01 go-live:

1) Redwood will finalize SPO line items using: Annual Commit = 1,350 seats (RDW-ACME-Y1); Burst Metered SKU = RDW-BURST; pricing as per attached draft.
2) Redwood to submit SPO via DocuSign by 2026-07-23 COB. Annette to route SPO to AWS billing for settlement routing verification.
3) Acme: please confirm the PO (ACME-PO-2026-4087) and sign the SPO when received (DocuSign).
4) Redwood finance will issue monthly invoices; include PO & SPO ID. Payment terms Net30.

I've attached the final draft PO and the completed SPO template. If there are no surprises from AWS billing, we will target activation 2026-08-01 and invoice for the committed portion pro-rated to that date.

Thanks everyone — I'll follow up when I submit the SPO.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198]
[Attachments: redwood_draft_po_acme_20260722.pdf (application/pdf); completed_spo_rdw_acme_20260722.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
